descripcion.en: The third conditional talks about an unreal past: if we had checked, we wouldn't have lost it. At B1 the goal is to build the form correctly for the first time and recognise it as the language of regret about the past.
descripcion.de: Der «third conditional» beschreibt eine irreale Vergangenheit: «if we had checked, we wouldn't have lost it». Auf B1-Niveau geht es darum, die Form erstmals korrekt zu bilden und sie als Ausdruck von Bedauern über die Vergangenheit zu erkennen.
descripcion.es: El «third conditional» habla de un pasado irreal: «if we had checked, we wouldn't have lost it». En B1, el objetivo es formar correctamente la estructura por primera vez y reconocerla como una forma de expresar arrepentimiento por el pasado.
descripcion.fr: Le «third conditional» parle d'un passé irréel : «if we had checked, we wouldn't have lost it». Au niveau B1, l'objectif est de construire correctement la forme pour la première fois et de la reconnaître comme une façon d'exprimer un regret concernant le passé.
descripcion.it: Il «third conditional» parla di un passato irreale: «if we had checked, we wouldn't have lost it». Al livello B1, l'obiettivo è costruire correttamente la forma per la prima volta e riconoscerla come linguaggio del rimpianto per il passato.
descripcion.pt: O «third conditional» fala de um passado irreal: «if we had checked, we wouldn't have lost it». No nível B1, o objetivo é formar corretamente a estrutura pela primeira vez e reconhecê-la como uma forma de expressar arrependimento sobre o passado.

filas.en: I would have called you sooner.
filas.pt: Eu teria ligado para você antes.

texto.en: If we had checked the address, we wouldn't have gotten lost.
texto.de: Wenn wir die Adresse überprüft hätten, hätten wir uns nicht verlaufen.
texto.es: Si hubiéramos comprobado la dirección, no nos habríamos perdido.
texto.fr: Si nous avions vérifié l'adresse, nous ne nous serions pas perdus.
texto.it: Se avessimo controllato l'indirizzo, non ci saremmo persi.
texto.pt: Se tivéssemos verificado o endereço, não teríamos nos perdido.

texto.en: If I had known, I would have called you.
texto.de: Wenn ich es gewusst hätte, hätte ich dich angerufen.
texto.es: Si lo hubiera sabido, te habría llamado.
texto.fr: Si je l'avais su, je t'aurais appelé.
texto.it: Se l'avessi saputo, ti avrei chiamato.
texto.pt: Se eu soubesse, teria ligado para você.

texto.en: We might have arrived on time if the train hadn't been delayed.
texto.de: Wir wären vielleicht rechtzeitig angekommen, wenn der Zug keine Verspätung gehabt hätte.
texto.es: Quizá habríamos llegado a tiempo si el tren no se hubiera retrasado.
texto.fr: Nous serions peut-être arrivés à l'heure si le train n'avait pas été retardé.
texto.it: Forse saremmo arrivati in orario se il treno non fosse stato in ritardo.
texto.pt: Talvez tivéssemos chegado a tempo se o trem não tivesse atrasado.

notas.en: The past perfect (had + participle) is used in the if-clause, and would have + participle in the main clause.
notas.de: Im if-Satz steht das «past perfect» (had + Partizip), im Hauptsatz would have + Partizip.
notas.es: En la oración con if se usa «past perfect» (had + participio) y en la principal would have + participio.
notas.fr: Dans la proposition en if, on utilise le «past perfect» (had + participe passé), et dans la principale would have + participe passé.
notas.it: Nella proposizione con if si usa il «past perfect» (had + participio), mentre nella principale si usa would have + participio.
notas.pt: Na oração com if, usa-se o «past perfect» (had + particípio), e na oração principal, would have + particípio.

notas.en: Would never appears inside the if-clause.
notas.es: Would nunca aparece en la oración con if.
notas.fr: Would ne s'emploie jamais dans la proposition en if.
notas.it: Would non compare mai nella proposizione con if.
notas.pt: Would nunca aparece na oração com if.

notas.en: This structure is used only for a past that did not happen — both halves are unreal.
notas.de: Diese Struktur wird nur für eine Vergangenheit verwendet, die nicht eingetreten ist – beide Satzteile sind irreal.
notas.es: Esta estructura se usa solo para un pasado que no ocurrió: ambas partes son irreales.
notas.fr: Cette structure s'utilise uniquement pour un passé qui ne s'est pas produit : les deux parties sont irréelles.
notas.it: Questa struttura si usa solo per un passato che non si è verificato: entrambe le parti sono irreali.
notas.pt: Essa estrutura é usada apenas para um passado que não aconteceu — as duas partes são irreais.

es.en: Spanish has an exact equivalent with «si» + «pluscuamperfecto de subjuntivo» and the conditional perfect («si hubiéramos revisado, no nos habríamos perdido»), so the logic transfers directly.
es.es: El español tiene un equivalente exacto con «si» + pluscuamperfecto de subjuntivo y condicional compuesto («si hubiéramos revisado, no nos habríamos perdido»), por lo que la lógica se transfiere directamente.

de.en: German uses «hätte» in both halves («Wenn wir es geprüft hätten, hätten wir uns nicht verlaufen»), which leads to If we had checked, we had not got lost. English needs had in the if-clause and would have in the result.
de.de: Im Deutschen steht in beiden Satzhälften «hätte» («Wenn wir es geprüft hätten, hätten wir uns nicht verlaufen»). Die wörtliche Übertragung ergibt «If we had checked, we had not got lost». Im Englischen braucht man «had» im «if»-Satz und «would have» im Ergebnissatz.

it.en: Italian has an exact equivalent («se avessimo controllato, non ci saremmo persi»), so the logic transfers directly. In colloquial Italian the «imperfetto» sometimes replaces both halves («se controllavamo, non ci perdevamo»), which can lead to if we checked, we didn't get lost.
it.it: L'italiano ha un equivalente esatto («se avessimo controllato, non ci saremmo persi»), quindi la logica si trasferisce direttamente. Nell'italiano colloquiale, però, l'imperfetto può sostituire entrambe le forme («se controllavamo, non ci perdevamo»), il che può portare a «if we checked, we didn't get lost».

fr.en: French has an exact equivalent («si nous avions vérifié, nous ne nous serions pas perdus»), including the rule that the conditional never follows «si». The logic and the form both transfer directly.
fr.fr: Le français a un équivalent exact («si nous avions vérifié, nous ne nous serions pas perdus»), y compris la règle selon laquelle le conditionnel ne suit jamais «si». La logique et la forme se transfèrent donc directement.

pt.en: Portuguese has an exact equivalent («se tivéssemos verificado, não nos teríamos perdido»), so the logic transfers directly. In colloquial European Portuguese the result clause often uses «tínhamos», which leads to we had not got lost instead of we wouldn't have got lost.
pt.pt: O português tem um equivalente exato («se tivéssemos verificado, não nos teríamos perdido»), então a lógica se transfere diretamente. No português europeu coloquial, porém, a oração de resultado pode usar «tínhamos», o que leva a «we had not got lost» em vez de «we wouldn't have got lost».

errores.en: Using would have in the if-clause.
errores.es: Usar would have en la oración con if.
errores.fr: Utiliser would have dans la proposition en if.
errores.it: Usare would have nella proposizione con if.
errores.pt: Usar would have na oração com if.

errores.en: Dropping have: if I had known, I would known.
errores.de: Have weglassen: if I had known, I would known.
errores.es: Omitir have: if I had known, I would known.
errores.fr: Oublier have : if I had known, I would known.
errores.it: Omettere have: if I had known, I would known.
errores.pt: Omitir have: if I had known, I would known.

errores.en: Using the wrong participle: would have went instead of would have gone.
errores.de: Das falsche Partizip verwenden: «would have went» statt «would have gone».
errores.es: Usar el participio incorrecto: would have went en lugar de would have gone.
errores.fr: Utiliser le mauvais participe : would have went au lieu de would have gone.
errores.it: Usare il participio sbagliato: would have went invece di would have gone.
errores.pt: Usar o particípio errado: would have went em vez de would have gone.

es.en: «*habría venido*» rendered with *had*: *I would had come* instead of *I would have come*.
es.es: Traducir «*habría venido*» con «*had*»: «*I would had come*» en lugar de «*I would have come*».

de.en: «*wäre gekommen*» rendered with *be*: *I would be come* instead of *I would have come*.
de.de: «*wäre gekommen*» mit «*be*» übertragen: «*I would be come*» statt «*I would have come*».

it.en: «*sarei venuto*» rendered with *be*: *I would be come* instead of *I would have come*.
it.it: Rendere «*sarei venuto*» con «*be*»: «*I would be come*» invece di «*I would have come*».

fr.en: «*je serais venu*» rendered with *be*: *I would be come* instead of *I would have come*.
fr.fr: Rendre «*je serais venu*» avec «*be*» : «*I would be come*» au lieu de «*I would have come*».

pt.en: «*teria vindo*» rendered with *had*: *I would had come* instead of *I would have come*.
pt.pt: Traduzir «*teria vindo*» com «*had*»: «*I would had come*» em vez de «*I would have come*».

consigna.en: Describe a time when too much waste was produced — at home, at work or at an event — and what would have been different.
consigna.de: Beschreibe eine Situation, in der zu viel Abfall entstand – zu Hause, bei der Arbeit oder bei einer Veranstaltung – und was anders gewesen wäre.
consigna.es: Describe una ocasión en la que se produjo demasiada basura —en casa, en el trabajo o en un evento— y qué habría sido diferente.
consigna.fr: Décris une situation où trop de déchets ont été produits — à la maison, au travail ou lors d'un événement — et explique ce qui aurait été différent.
consigna.it: Descrivi una situazione in cui sono stati prodotti troppi rifiuti — a casa, al lavoro o a un evento — e che cosa sarebbe stato diverso.
consigna.pt: Descreva uma situação em que houve desperdício demais — em casa, no trabalho ou em um evento — e o que teria sido diferente.

promptCorreccion.en: Focus only on the third conditional. Check for would inside the if-clause and check the participle forms in both parts of the sentence carefully. Do not rewrite the text.
promptCorreccion.de: Konzentriere dich nur auf den «third conditional». Prüfe, ob would im if-Satz vorkommt, und kontrolliere die Partizipformen in beiden Satzteilen sorgfältig. Schreibe den Text nicht um.
promptCorreccion.es: Concéntrate únicamente en el «third conditional». Comprueba si aparece would en la oración con if y revisa cuidadosamente los participios en ambas partes de la oración. No reescribas el texto.
promptCorreccion.fr: Concentre-toi uniquement sur le «third conditional». Vérifie s'il y a would dans la proposition en if et contrôle soigneusement les participes dans les deux parties de la phrase. Ne réécris pas le texte.
promptCorreccion.it: Concentrati solo sul «third conditional». Controlla se compare would nella proposizione con if e verifica attentamente le forme del participio in entrambe le parti della frase. Non riscrivere il testo.
promptCorreccion.pt: Concentre-se apenas no «third conditional». Verifique se há would na oração com if e confira cuidadosamente as formas do particípio nas duas partes da frase. Não reescreva o texto.
